title: Uth gaye dunya se ali haye
body:
Shor hai aalam me yahi haaye haaye
<<MINI>>
Uth gaye dunya se ali haaye haaye
<<DIVIDER>>
Ho gaye hasnain yateemo yaseer
mar gaye daamaade nabi haaye haaye
Zainabo Kulsoom udhaati hai qaak
Uth'ta hai taboote Ali haaye haaye
<<DIVIDER>>
Zulm namaazi pa ye kaisa hua
Maara hai sajde me shaqi haaye haaye
Lega ghareebo'n ki qabar koun ab
<<MINI>>
Uth gaye dunya se Ali haaye haaye
<<DIVIDER>>
Qaak udhaate hai Hussain o Hasan
Rote hai Abbase Ali haaye haaye
Qaak udhaakar yahi qaadim kaho
Haaye Ali Haaye Ali haaye haaye
